tasks.short: Develop teaching aids and study materials

steps.what: Define teaching aid objectives and select approved source material
Develop instructional software, multimedia aids or study materials

loop.purpose: Draft explanations and practice materials within the approved brief
loop.input: Teacher-selected sources, objectives, learner level and format
loop.output: Draft aid with source links and answer rationale
loop.check: Teacher tests every worked example and checks explanations teach the intended practical skill without unsafe shortcuts
loop.stop: One revision then manual development if factual or practical errors persist
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates format materials but cannot draft varied explanations and worked examples

steps.what: Test the teaching aid and approve its final version

tasks.design: Reuse native {LMS} activity templates and {DOCS} layouts, with a bounded loop for explanation and practice-item drafts. The teacher checks factual meaning, practical safety, accessibility and worked answers before releasing the aid.
tasks.previous_blocker: Creating examples and rewriting explanations takes time even when the curriculum is settled.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded drafting step can work from approved sources and a teacher-written brief.
tasks.still_hard: A convincing worked example may teach an incorrect or unsafe method.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether a material helps a learner perform the intended practical skill.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft production; the teacher keeps final educational responsibility.

reach.task: Make practice resources accessible and testable
reach.learn: Accessible layouts, answer rationales and activity testing

evidence.claim: Teacher-reviewed teaching-aid drafting is an E1 design; the digest supplies no measured result for vocational aid production.

assumptions: Boundary is producing aids from an already approved curriculum, excluding curriculum planning and live instruction.

The teacher produces objective, level, format, source passages, practice constraints and equipment limits in s1; all 20 hours remain. Absent specifications require clarification, not invented instructions.

Test native activity banks and templates first. The 25 retained s2 hours include correction; all 30 testing hours remain. The scenario concerns text and simple multimedia aids, not validation of complex custom instructional software.
unknowns: Resource permissions and native authoring features
Proportion of aids requiring custom software
research_questions: Do reviewed drafts reduce production time after worked-answer, accessibility and safety checks?

already_counted.description: Brief capture, draft correction and final testing

incremental.description: Maintain source versions and monitor recurring draft errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact aid version, media, instructions, worked answers and accessibility checks; edits require reapproval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+25+30=75; gross 25%, minus four upkeep gives 21% central net. Low assumes only eight drafting hours removable because aids need substantial correction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on faculty and school committees

steps.what: Review committee proposals on budgets, curricula and diploma requirements
Deliberate with faculty and school committees and agree recommendations

tasks.design: Keep committee preparation and deliberation with the teacher using papers in {DOCS}. No separate minute-taking or report-writing baseline is assumed within committee service.
tasks.previous_blocker: Budget and qualification choices require interpreting trade-offs and hearing colleagues.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing committee papers already support that work.
tasks.still_hard: Competing educational and resource priorities need negotiation.
tasks.human_edge: Contribute practical teaching evidence and accept responsibility for recommendations.
tasks.altitude: Committee responsibilities and time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Committee judgement and deliberation retain their time; no administrative baseline is invented.

assumptions: Boundary is this teacher's paper review and participation; chair and secretary labour is outside the denominator.
No new structured input or automated decision is introduced.
Native document access is sufficient. No deployment or incremental upkeep is added, so zero new work is justified.
unknowns: Committee remit and current preparation burden
research_questions: Which committee decisions need direct teaching evidence?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Committee participation remains human work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify experts whose practice fits the planned lecture
Discuss the lecture purpose, scope and participation with the expert
Arrange the lecture time, room and final invitation

tasks.design: Use native {CALENDAR} room availability and an {EMAIL} invitation template after the teacher and expert agree the lecture brief. Keep expert selection, scope negotiation and final booking confirmation with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability and room details are repeatedly copied between messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendar availability and reusable invitations reduce repeated coordination.
tasks.still_hard: An expert's suitability and willingness depend on a personal discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a credible speaker and agree a useful connection to the course.
tasks.altitude: Less booking correspondence; professional relationship work is unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate guest access and room arrangements
reach.learn: Room equipment, guest permissions and booking constraints

evidence.claim: Native calendar availability and invitation templates can reduce repeated booking work; the time estimate is E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is expert selection, lecture agreement and booking, excluding lecture delivery and expert preparation.

The teacher captures expert contact, lecture scope and availability in s2 and checks date, room, duration and equipment in retained s3 time. Existing room bookings produce room availability; no new expert self-service work is required.
Ambiguous availability or room conflicts return to manual correspondence inside the 12 retained s3 hours. Test native calendar templates before custom automation.
research_questions: Does native availability remove correspondence without transferring new work to experts?

already_counted.description: Lecture agreement and booking capture, checks and confirmation

incremental.description: Maintain invitation template and resolve booking-rule faults

approvals.approved_version: Exact expert, lecture scope, date, duration, room, equipment and invitation recipients; changes require reconfirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+40+12=82; gross 18%, minus three upkeep gives 15% central net. Low assumes only six correspondence hours removable because external availability remains uncertain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review enrollment applications and request missing information

steps.what: Review enrollment applications against published information requirements
Draft correspondence requesting specific additional application information

loop.purpose: Draft a clear request from teacher-identified information gaps
loop.input: Application review notes, documents and requirements
loop.output: Draft request with each requested item tied to a teacher-identified gap
loop.check: Teacher verifies each item is genuinely missing, necessary and neutrally described without implying rejection
loop.stop: One revision then manual correspondence if any request is unsupported
loop.why_not_simpler: A template handles fixed fields but varied document gaps require contextual wording

steps.what: Confirm and send the information request to the applicant

tasks.design: Keep application review with the teacher and use a bounded {EMAIL} draft from the teacher's specific information gaps and published requirements in {DOCS}. The teacher checks necessity, tone and recipient before sending; no admission ranking or decision is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requests repeat standard explanations but each document gap needs precise wording.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded drafting step can express already identified gaps without assessing eligibility.
tasks.still_hard: A document may contain equivalent evidence in an unfamiliar format.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret the applicant's circumstances and avoid unnecessary information requests.
tasks.altitude: Less correspondence drafting; application review and admission authority are unchanged.

reach.learn: Equivalent documents and appropriate information limits

evidence.claim: Drafting teacher-specified information requests with a bounded semantic review is an E1 design, not a sourced admissions capability.

assumptions: Boundary is review and missing-information correspondence, excluding admissions selection, applicant response work and enrolment posting.

The teacher produces application identifier, requirement references and gap notes in s1, retaining all 40 hours. Applicant contact comes from the existing application and is verified in s3; unreadable evidence returns to manual review rather than a model decision.
Test native request templates first. Use the loop only where contextual wording remains necessary, with correction in retained s2 time and final release in s3.
unknowns: Access and permitted use of application documents
research_questions: Are drafted requests necessary and accurate when compared with the full application evidence?

already_counted.description: Application review, draft correction and message release

incremental.description: Maintain request guidance and inspect recurring draft errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact applicant, request text, required items and requirement references; changed content or recipient requires new approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+17.5+25=82.5; gross 17.5%, minus four upkeep gives 13.5% central net. Low assumes only six drafting hours removed because evidence gaps require extensive correction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce first drafts and booking correspondence while retaining teaching-aid validation, committee judgement and application review.
reach: Work with instructional designers and admissions administrators on clear evidence requirements
role.ambitious_version: A vocational teacher who spends less time on repeated wording and more time on sound educational choices.
